name: Life Console
description: Keyboard-first planner that shows what to do right now: time-block your week, count down deadlines and link tasks to goals.
longDescription:
Life Console answers one question all day: what should I be doing right now? The Command Center shows the current time block with a live countdown, the task to work on, what comes next and the next deadline.

Plan the week by moving tasks from a backlog into a daily budget and onto the timeline; Auto time-box fills free gaps by priority. Deadlines show as ticking countdowns, and strategic plans break a vision into goals and milestones that tasks link to.

Multi-user, keyboard-first, works offline and installs on phones with push reminders. License: AGPL-3.0.
